Name: tbrepetition
Description: TBencoding repetition contrast for the GLM bake-off (mmmdata-agents docs/workbench/glm-strategy/, DECIDED 2026-09-08): first presentation vs any later presentation of the same items, pooled over encoding conditions 2 and 3, matched stimuli. The `tbrepetition` adapter (neuroimaging.glm.adapters) derives the trial_type column from every run of the subject: `first`/`later` for non-anchor repeated items ordered by (run, onset) within a session, `once` for items shown a single time, `anchor` for the six items shown in every session, which the contrast excludes. Each trial is one 3 s event (the image row; the word row shares its onset). Event-related, 42 runs over 14 sessions per subject; the runner needs all of them prepared at once.
